# E014 -- Olympic Games Tokyo 2020 Emblem Usage Guidelines

## Metadata
- **Company:** Tokyo 2020 Organising Committee
- **Industry:** Sports/Events
- **Year:** 2018
- **Source file:** Olympic_game_tokyo_2020.pdf
- **Pages:** ~13
- **Language:** EN
- **Pages sampled:** 1-2, 6-7, 12-13

## Brand Strategy
- Emblem Usage Guidelines for National Olympic Committees (NOCs), Version 2.0
- Non-commercial use only -- strict commercial rights structure within the Olympic movement
- Only Worldwide Olympic Partners and Tokyo 2020 Sponsors have commercial usage rights
- NOCs authorized for promotion/advertising of the Games in their territories
- Brand assets include: emblems, mascots, pictograms
- Contact: noc.svc@tokyo2020.jp for access via Tokyo 2020 Extranet

## Logo
- Tokyo 2020 Emblem: full-color primary version on white backgrounds
- Boxed emblem: for photographic/complex/coloured backgrounds
- Monochrome versions available in six colors: Blue, Yellow, Black, Green, Red, White
- "Games Distinctive Element" + wordmark as emblem components
- Strict co-branding hierarchy: Tokyo 2020 emblem must be smaller than NOC emblem on business cards
- Clothing: max size 30 cm2 or 44mm width, used only once per item
- Wordmark can be reproduced in entirety or in generic font (Arial, Helvetica)
- Forbidden to associate emblem with Manufacturer Identification
- Emblem must appear alone on competition clothing

## Typography
- No proprietary typeface specified -- generic fonts (Arial, Helvetica) referenced for wordmark reproduction
- This is an emblem usage guide, not a full brand guide

## Color
- Emblem Blue: Pantone 281C / C100 M80 Y0 K50 / R0 G32 B99
- Blue: Pantone 3005C / C100 M37 Y0 K0 / R0 G129 B200
- Yellow: Pantone 137C / C0 M34 Y91 K0 / R252 G177 B49
- Black: Pantone 426C / C0 M0 Y0 K100 / R0 G0 B0
- Green: Pantone 355C / C100 M0 Y100 K0 / R0 G166 B81
- Red: Pantone 192C / C0 M94 Y65 K0 / R238 G51 B78
- White: C0 M0 Y0 K0 / R255 G255 B255
- Full Pantone + CMYK + RGB specifications for all colors

## Graphics
- Pictograms and mascots referenced but not detailed in sampled pages
- Games Distinctive Element as graphic component of emblem

## Photography
- Emblem placement over photographic backgrounds requires boxed version
- No dedicated photography style section (this is a usage guide, not a full brand guide)

## Applications
- Letterhead: emblem placement specified
- Business cards: restricted to NOC management staff involved with Tokyo 2020 Games
- Websites: editorial use only; emblem must be clearly separated from commercial content
- Clothing/uniforms: strict size and placement rules
- Envelopes and postcards: use NOT permitted
- Materials with third-party brands: NOT allowed (except Worldwide Olympic Partners)

## Tone of Voice
- Formal, regulatory, governance-oriented
- Legal precision throughout -- "hereinafter," "authorised," "forbidden"
- Reflects IOC institutional communication standards

## Outliers
- Not a brand identity guide but an emblem usage/compliance document -- extremely restrictive
- Business card usage limited to specific staff roles -- unusual level of access control
- Envelope/postcard prohibition is specific and restrictive
- Clear commercial vs. non-commercial boundary enforced throughout
- Triple color specification (Pantone/CMYK/RGB) for all seven colors -- production-ready
- Version 2.0 indicates iterative governance refinement
- Sponsor separation rules on websites are highly prescriptive (spatial separation, no association)

## Quality Score
- **Score: 3/5** -- Highly specialized emblem usage compliance document rather than a full brand guide. Excellent for its purpose: clear rules, detailed color specifications, practical application examples (letterhead, business cards, websites, clothing). Lacks typography, photography, tone of voice, and broader visual identity depth because it is scoped to NOC emblem usage only. Very well-organized for a governance document.
